body:
Background: I am a male, 23-year-old college student. I'm a pretty conventional partier, and have previously only used alcohol, marijuana, salvia, xanax, and a barely operant dose of shrooms. I smoked marijuana about every couple of weeks in high school, usually just to party. The other drugs I did only once each out of curiosity and/or convenience. Ironically, I almost entirely let go of partying altogether for my first 2 1/2 years of college. Now, I drink socially for nights out and find myself smoking weed maybe 1 or two times a year when it is offered. Overall, I'd describe myself as pretty vanilla.
However, I have always had an interest in drugs and their effects, whether I was willing to try them or not. As I've grown a little older, I've become less scared to experiment with things so long as I am using in a way that is considered standard or reasonable by those who are familiar with the applicable drug. Within the past year leading up to this night, I came to find MDMA alluring enough to actively seek it out. My first attempt at scoring Molly  left me with dud capsules that did nothing but dilate my pupils. 3 weeks later, I went to see Alvin Risk at a club in Philly with some friends from home that are more experienced with MDMA and the EDM scene in general. We had planned to find Molly before the show, but they decided to settle for making a last minute effort at the venue. I didn't have my heart set on it and I wasn't sure that any of us would be successful, so I began drinking. I had drunk a moderate amount (~6 drinks) relatively quickly by the time I ran into my friend, who well call M, in the bathroom after about an hour and a half. He told me that he and our other friends had found someone inside selling capsules and that they were good. Though I didn't consider buying it from a stranger at the club to be the ideal method for acquiring it, nor did I consider a powder-filled capsule to be the ideal form, I was enthusiastic enough to buy one for myself and my SO, K. I felt comfortable knowing that my friends had already taken them and begun to feel the appropriate high. M told me to crack that shit right in my mouth, which I did, before finding K and giving her a capsule.
I began rolling quickly and felt a high that, while distinct, was not overwhelmingly intense or intimidating. I really started to get what others would talk about in their accounts of their rolls. To my surprise, I found the high to be a much mental high than a physical body high. For someone who is prone to some level of self-conscious paranoia even when only smoking weed, it was refreshingly easy to let MDMA do its thing to me. For me, the major draw of Molly was the breakdown of social barriers.
For me, the major draw of Molly was the breakdown of social barriers.
Sincerity and a lack of social inhibition are things I highly appreciate and that I consider myself to be pretty good at already, but that I wanted to maximize. Molly delivered, and the interpersonal lightness was the first thing I noticed. It was like I was drunk without the disorientation or stupidity. After a short warm up period of dancing, K and I decided to return to the VIP for a quick break before the headliners.
While not severely disoriented, I began to willingly lose track of time at this point, which was kind of nice. Since my remaining party of 7 (5 rolling) were more less ready to commit to the dance floor, I began pouring shots for the people around us who seemed bored or uncomfortable, pointing at them to single them out and summon them to my table to drink my last bottle of vodka. My rollers and I polished off my orange juice carafe for good measure.
It was around this time K made friends with a cute redhead, B, and what I understood to be her its complicated ex-boyfriend, R, who we gave our table to as we went back to the dance floor. The local DJs were through at this point, and Schoolboy/Popeska were turning it on, though I wasn't paying attention to who was on stage at this point. As we danced, I began to notice the sensual aspect of the roll. To be honest, tales of MDMA may have over-hyped the touch-and-feel benefits of the drug and had led me to believe that every bit of contact felt orgasmic. In my experience, to touch someone else gave me satisfaction akin to ASMR, which was still very pleasant and enjoyable. K and I indulged, and we became intimate very quickly and intensely in the crowd, kissing and rubbing each other all over. The term is clichéd, but I would liken our activity to exploration of each others bodies, covering everything as to not let any part of her body go unaddressed. Every once in a while she would go down my pants and rub my dick, and I would say something especially dirty to her about what I wanted to do to her later. Even our new friend B got in on the action, getting very close with K at times and briefly making out with her, which I welcomed. Were in an open relationship and that would be fair play even if we werent rolling, for anyone concerned, though I would have liked to be involved. Alas, I wasnt aware of what they were doing until it was over. We took one more break at the table, and I took the opportunity to wet my very dry mouth with some ice cubes from our tabletop cooler. Though I did so as an impulse, I took a moment here to take a conscious inventory of what I had and havent consumed, and had a lucid reflection on how much water I needed. Its quite possible that my dose was somewhat light, because I didnt feel terribly thirsty, and the ice cubes were very satisfying. Ever-friendly, I fed R, B, and K some ice cubes from my hand and made my way back to the floor with K.
Alvin was on now, and the lights really began to capture my attention. At this point, I can only imagine the extent to which I looked like that guy, the sterotypical first-time raver that just looks wide eyed all over the flashing room. I must have stared at the projections main projector for 15 seconds at a time. This place was pretty nice from a sober perspective, but at this moment I felt like I was in a visual paradise. Once I internalized the lights, I got in gear and let the (incredible) music take me over for the last hour of the show. We left the club, took a cab back to my friends place, and smoked little bit of weed while we chilled and regrouped for about an hour before going back to Ks to crash. The 1-2 times a year I smoke weed are usually times like this when Im so far gone on something else like alcohol that I just say fuck it and start taking hits. Not even sure if I could isolate the effects of the marijuana at this point, despite the fact that I was slowly coming down from the Molly.
We got to Ks around 5am, and if I werent already intending on having sex with her, I was now obligated. Most of the high was gone, but I was still very uninhibited and passionate, and we fucked slowly and deeply for about a half hour before I conceded that I was way too tired and we would not be able to come without more effort than either of us were willing to put forth. We fell asleep surprisingly easily. May have had help from the weed, but I was also just straight up exhausted.
Hangover was minimal. Whatever the dosage was, Id have to say it was perfect, given that it gave me a very good high with almost no low. Still exhausted today because we only got a few hours of sleep, but a real night of sleep will have me back at 100%. As far as nights out go, this is as close as Ive ever come to perfection.
